description.p: QtParted is a graphical partition editor based on libparted. It shows the partitions of every disk, lets you queue changes and applies them in one go, with a detailed log of every step.

ul.li: Create msdos (MBR), GPT and the other partition tables supported by libparted
Create, delete and format partitions, with MiB or cylinder alignment
Over 20 file systems: ext2/3/4, btrfs, xfs, f2fs, fat16/32, exfat, ntfs, swap, LVM2 PV and more
Set partition flags and GPT partition names
Pending operations can be undone before anything is written

description.p: Rewrite for Qt 6 with a new core modelled on GParted.
